BL-1404 — A recorded babysitter waive silences the operator escalation as well as the coordinator nudge: decide-escalations is fed the raw findings, so a waived Article 4.2 finding still wakes the LLM operator every cooldown forever - one key, both channels
What it solves: No consumer `required_wiring` anchor: the call site is the one line in
`babysitter_check.bb` this parcel changes, so any anchor would be
satisfied by the parcel's own diff (BL-1235 fail-open). The BL-1344 runner
extended with the escalation channel is what proves the wiring.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. Raised by the coordinator on 2026-09-04 after the same six Article 4.2 findings re-fired unchanged all evening.
BL-1404 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1404" (or "reject BL-1404 <reason>") to act.
